causal_local_reproduction.old_observer_boundary: MutationObserver callback queried only the button's final disabled/text state. A disabled Capturing DOM state that starts and ends in one JavaScript turn produces ordered mutation records but no disabled final-state sample.

causal_local_reproduction.recorded_sequence: disabled attribute added; Capturing text added; disabled attribute removed; Re-capture text added; callback then sees enabled Re-capture.
causal_local_reproduction.green: The repaired observer replays mutations in order, requires disabled and the busy label to overlap on the same active Scrape button, reconciles the reconstructed final state with the actual DOM, and preserves the observed label.
causal_local_reproduction.negative_guard: A disabled state that ends before Capturing text appears remains unverified; the nonoverlap test passes.
causal_local_reproduction.test_result: Five focused DOM observer tests pass, covering replacement, tooltip title movement, same-turn child-list and text-node changes, and nonoverlap.
